name: std::strstr
intro: Finds the first occurrence of the byte string needle in the byte string pointed to by haystack. The terminating null characters are not compared.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
haystack

 -

 pointer to the null-terminated byte string to examine


 needle

 -

 pointer to the null-terminated byte string to search for

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to the first character of the found substring in haystack, or a null pointer if no such character is found. If needle points to an empty string, haystack is returned.

examples.output:
Found "not" starting at (4): "not. Do, or do not. There is no try."
Found "not" starting at (19): "not. There is no try."
